description: List the files a deployed workflow's runs have stored in its own storage bucket in the user's Cloudflare account, with each file's key, size and last-modified time. `readPath` is the URL template that downloads one file. A workflow that never stored a file returns an empty list, not an error. Pass `cursor` back for the next page.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: list_workflow_files
title: List workflow files
